rites.name: Silereinora
rites.text: Silereinora is the concept of silence before sound in Lyariel, the hush that the Singing breaks open as the first roots of the world condense. It is less a being than a pressure, a stillness so complete that its absence became the first note.

rites.name: Viallium
rites.text: Viallium is the concept of the Lattice of Doors, the first measure the Courts of Lyariel agreed upon to weigh what may pass between worlds. Its seat in the Arcane Realm is a balance that tilts whenever a threshold is opened or sealed during the age of divine trials.

rites.name: Ilolaari
rites.text: Ilolaari is the concept of a binding oath sworn before the council of the Courts, the bond that holds a divine trial to its terms. In the Holy Age its flame was kept in temples and carried by the orders who guarded the doors between worlds.

rites.name: Teones
rites.text: A ritual working that a trickster hero attempts in order to bring back his fallen companions and a cunning fox spirit. It seeks to restore the lost to life.

rites.name: Niantor
rites.text: A deep, clear understanding that temple scholars cultivate as the highest kind of insight. It is regarded as a form of wisdom that guides the mind toward truth.

rites.name: Corostes
rites.text: A state of awakened clarity that a seeker reaches after long inner discipline. In one tradition it is treated as the same thing as deep wisdom.

rites.name: Lyarlema
rites.text: Lyarlema is the quiet concept of the Weave as it is first planted in Lyariel during the Seeding, when the makers lay its threads across empty air. Its powers sleep within the lattice, waiting for a hand to draw them awake.

rites.name: Ilonaruta
rites.text: Ilonaruta is the concept of the Weave, a lattice of quiet power the makers planted in Lyariel during the Seeding, when sleeping forces were bound into the land. In the Holy Age its name was spoken by temple orders who learned to kindle flame along its threads.

rites.name: Ukanaloma
rites.text: Ukanaloma is a concept in Lyariel, a silent principle that the makers sowed into the Weave during the Seeding, when quiet powers were set to sleep. Its presence is felt in the Age of Sundering as the old bonds between landfalls began to fray and split apart.

rites.name: Amaraunes
rites.text: Amaraunes is the sleeping pattern of the Weave laid down during the Seeding, a latent lattice of quiet powers that the makers planted before the Age of Sundering. When landfall broke old bonds, its threads kept humming beneath the broken ground, waiting to be woken by those who could hear them.

rites.name: Vhairkok
rites.text: Vhairkok is a rite-event of the Arcane Realm of Lyariel, staged in the Holy Age when temple orders kindled sacred fires along the walls. Its ritual lit a ring of flame that briefly bent the boundary between the Walled Age's holding wards and the open lands beyond.

rites.name: Veneinys
rites.text: Veneinys is an Arcane concept of the Lyariel omniverse, a Sky-Warden who has attained a borrowed immortal body. Each of his fine strands can be reshaped into any substance, and he scatters them as swarms of tireless, sharp-eyed copies that blades cannot touch.

rites.name: Nuerliriel
rites.text: Nuerliriel is a restless arcane discipline of seventy-two shaping-forms, each a way of folding the self into a new body or into the surrounding stone and air. Practitioners of the third age of Lyariel use it to slip through sealed gates and to become the fire, mist, or hollow reed that a situation demands.

rites.name: Oriellinys
rites.text: Oriellinys is a cultivated art in the Arcane realm of Lyariel, taught to bind a practitioner's breath into a rolling cushion of mist that carries them across great distances in a single leap. Its practitioners are known for vanishing mid-sentence and reappearing leagues away, though the art is famed more for its speed than for its destructive force.

rites.name: Nuala
rites.text: Nuala is a binding-chant of the Lyariel arcane tradition, sung to lock a caster's body against the fiercest blows. Its verses are said to hold for three breaths, after which the words must be recited anew.

rites.name: Miirla
rites.text: Miirla is a binding incantation of the Lyariel arcane tradition, sung into a circlet of hammered silver to bind unruly spirits to its wearer's will. When the circlet is spoken against, its ring tightens around the skull with a pain that can silence a dragon's roar. Scholars of the E6 era debate whether the bond is a gift of protection or a cruelty.

rites.name: Ryelaerlys
rites.text: Ryelaerlys is a concept of kindled stillness, a flame that burns without fuel by drawing on the mind's own resolve. In the Arcane realm of Lyariel's sixth era, it is said to be a discipline rather than a fire, one that lights the blood of those who have mastered their fear.

rites.name: Ryana
rites.text: Ryana is a concept of a sustained, rhythmic current of enchanted air that gathers the spirit of a listener and bends it toward one chosen intention. Its strongest form is said to scour the memory of a whole valley clean in a single breath.

rites.name: Oriila
rites.text: Oriila is the discipline of the Veiled Lattice, a severe art taught in Lyariel's arcane schools that bends a practitioner's breath into concentrated will. Its adepts are famed for moving stone and storm alike with a single exhalation, though each great working costs them a portion of their lifespan.

rites.name: Eleinneth
rites.text: Eleinneth is a discipline of woven starlight practiced in the Lyariel tide-cities, in which a practitioner binds their breath to the slow turning of the sky. Adepts who reach its final stage are said to outlast the stars that fed them, though most dissolve into mist before the threshold is crossed.

rites.name: Alaimwen
rites.text: Alaimwen is a discipline of woven resonance in the arcane realm of Lyariel, practiced by scholars who tune their breath to the hum of ley-threads. Its adepts believe that a single chord, held long enough, can unravel the foundations of a mountain range. Few reach the stage where their songs outlast their own bodies.

rites.name: Oriilluana
rites.text: Oriilluana is a sealed glyph-language of the Lyariel arcane powers, taught in cloistered schools where each syllable is bound to a fixed quantity of stored lightning. Its practitioners speak only short invocations, but a single fully spoken name can unseal a bound ward and release the energy of a small star's flare.

rites.name: Ilyirlora
rites.text: Ilyirlora is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in Lyariel, one of many routes practitioners take toward mastering their own nature. Its adherents hold that a true word can unmake what it names, and they train by sinking every sound into stillness until a single spoken syllable carries enormous force.
